page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a catchword at the lower right and a gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: sti[?], vel juxta filum narrationis unius alicujus quatuor Evangelistarum, vel etiam magis ex omnibus harmonicè contextam præponerem et explicarem; et nodos historicos aliasque difficulta-tes, quà ἐν φαινομένης ἀντιλογίας, quà exrei subjectæ qualitate aut circum-stantiis ortas dissolverem?
An tertiò pari ratione historiam sacram Ecclesiasticam ex Apostolorum Actibus & Epistolis secundum tem-porum ordinem dispositam?

Vel etiam quartò integram histori-am Biblicam utriusque Testamenti à mundo condito ad constitutam usque ab Apostolis Ecclesiam Christianam perpetuo filio deducerem, & rerum gestarum exempla ad usum confcien-tiæ & vitæ institutionem, quoad res ferret, accommodarem?

page.notes: The first word of the page, printed "fti" (long s), is a fragment carried over from the previous page and is uncertain. The Greek words after "quà" (ἐν φαινομένης ἀντιλογίας) are copied as printed; the first accent and the ἐν reading are doubtful. "exrei" is printed without a space. The catchword "An" and signature "a" are as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
